terms.definitionEn: A declaration that defines a constructor and instance members for a JavaScript object pattern.
terms.definitionAr: تعريف بيحدد constructor وأعضاء instances لنمط objects في JavaScript.

terms.definitionEn: A special class method called during instance creation to initialize the new object.
terms.definitionAr: method خاصة في الـ class بتتنادى وقت إنشاء instance عشان تهيأ الـ object.

terms.definitionEn: An access modifier allowing a member to be accessed from any visibility context.
terms.definitionAr: access modifier بيسمح بالوصول للعضو من أي نطاق وصول.

terms.definitionEn: A TypeScript access modifier that restricts a member to its declaring class in type checking.
terms.definitionAr: access modifier في TypeScript بيقصر العضو على الـ class اللي عرفته أثناء فحص الأنواع.

terms.definitionEn: A modifier that prevents a property from being reassigned outside its initialization points.
terms.definitionAr: modifier بيمنع إعادة إسناد property خارج نقاط التهيئة المسموحة.

terms.definitionEn: An access modifier that permits access in the declaring class and its subclasses.
terms.definitionAr: access modifier بيسمح بالوصول داخل الـ class والـ subclasses بتاعتها.

terms.definitionEn: A constructor parameter with an access or readonly modifier that also declares and initializes a property.
terms.definitionAr: parameter في constructor عليه access أو readonly modifier وبيعرف ويهيأ property كمان.

terms.definitionEn: A class clause that checks whether the instance side satisfies a declared interface contract.
terms.definitionAr: جزء في class بيتأكد إن ناحية الـ instance بتحقق عقد interface معلن.

terms.definitionEn: A base class that cannot be instantiated directly and may declare members for subclasses to implement.
terms.definitionAr: class أساسية ماينفعش نعمل منها instance مباشرة وممكن تعلن أعضاء للـ subclasses تنفذها.
terms.example: abstract class Shape { abstract area(): number; }

terms.definitionEn: A class member stored on the constructor rather than on each created instance.
terms.definitionAr: عضو بيتخزن على الـ constructor مش على كل instance بتتعمل.

terms.definitionEn: A strict compiler check requiring declared instance properties to be initialized or definitely assigned.
terms.definitionAr: فحص strict بيطلب تهيئة properties الـ instance المعلنة أو إثبات إسنادها.

terms.definitionEn: A member signature without an implementation that concrete subclasses must provide.
terms.definitionAr: توقيع عضو من غير implementation والـ subclasses العادية لازم تنفذه.
terms.example: abstract class Shape { abstract area(): number; }

questions.code:
class Lamp { on = false; }
const lamp = new Lamp();
questions.question: What does new Lamp() create?
options: A Lamp instance with its on field initialized
The Lamp class declaration converted to a string
A type-only value that does not exist in JavaScript
A tuple containing the class and its property
questions.explanation: The new expression creates an instance and initializes its field.
questions.explanationAr: تعبير new بيعمل instance وبيهيأ الـ field.

questions.code:
class Point { constructor(public x: number) {} }
const p = new Point(4);
questions.question: What happens to x during construction?
options: It is only a local constructor parameter and is not retained afterward
It is declared and initialized as an instance property
It is copied onto the Point class constructor as a static field
It is erased before the object is created and cannot be read
questions.explanation: The parameter property both declares x on instances and initializes it from the argument.
questions.explanationAr: الـ parameter property بتعرف x على الـ instance وبتسندلها argument.

questions.question: Why can the last line access token?
options: Every class field is private by default and auto-exposed
The expression creates a new token property on access
public allows access from outside the class
Access modifiers are valid only on constructors
questions.explanation: A public member is accessible from any visibility context.
questions.explanationAr: العضو public متاح للوصول من أي نطاق.

questions.code:
class Vault { private code = 'x'; }
new Vault().code;
questions.question: What does TypeScript report?
options: No error because private is a runtime getter
No error because every class property is public
An error because constructors cannot define fields
An access error because code is private to Vault
questions.explanation: The private modifier prevents access from outside the declaring class during type checking.
questions.explanationAr: private بيمنع الوصول من بره الـ class أثناء فحص الأنواع.

questions.question: What does the assignment produce?
options: A type error because id cannot be reassigned through this instance reference
A valid change because every declared class field is mutable after construction
A new Record instance with id equal to 8 returned by the assignment expression
A runtime conversion that changes the property's numeric value into readonly
questions.explanation: The readonly property cannot be reassigned after its permitted initialization.
questions.explanationAr: خاصية readonly ماينفعش تتغير بعد التهيئة المسموحة.

questions.code:
class Base { protected label = 'base'; }
class Child extends Base { read() { return this.label; } }
questions.question: Why can Child.read access label?
options: protected members are public on every unrelated object outside the class hierarchy
protected allows access inside the declaring class and subclasses
extends removes every access modifier from inherited members and makes them public
The property is re-declared automatically as a public member on each subclass
questions.explanation: protected members are accessible within the declaring class and its subclasses.
questions.explanationAr: أعضاء protected متاحة جوه الـ class والـ subclasses بتاعتها.

questions.code:
interface HasId { id: number }
class User implements HasId { id = 1; }
questions.question: What does implements check?
options: It creates a HasId instance at runtime
It copies the interface members onto User automatically
The class instance side satisfies the interface shape
It makes HasId a superclass of User
questions.explanation: implements checks compatibility with the interface but does not add runtime members.
questions.explanationAr: implements بيفحص توافق الـ instance مع interface لكنه مش بيضيف أعضاء وقت التشغيل.

questions.code:
abstract class Shape { abstract area(): number; }
class Square extends Shape { area() { return 4; } }
questions.question: What must a concrete Square provide?
options: A second constructor whose name matches the abstract base class
A static method called area that is stored on the class constructor
An interface declaration that copies every member from Shape
An implementation of the inherited abstract area member
questions.explanation: Concrete subclasses must implement inherited abstract members.
questions.explanationAr: الـ subclasses العادية لازم تنفذ الأعضاء abstract الموروثة.

questions.code: class User { name: string; }
questions.question: With strictPropertyInitialization enabled, what is reported?
options: An error because name is not initialized or definitely assigned
No error because all string properties default to an empty string
A runtime error as soon as the class is declared
No error because TypeScript initializes fields from their types
questions.explanation: The check requires instance properties to be initialized or definitely assigned.
questions.explanationAr: الفحص بيطلب تهيئة properties الـ instance أو إثبات إسنادها.

questions.code:
class Counter { value = 2; next() { return this.value + 1; } }
const result = new Counter().next();
questions.question: What runtime value is returned by next()?
options: undefined
questions.explanation: The field begins at 2 and next returns that value plus one.
questions.explanationAr: الـ field بتبدأ بـ 2 وnext بترجع القيمة زائد واحد.

questions.code:
class Meter { static unit = 'cm'; }
const result = Meter.unit;
questions.question: What runtime value is stored in result?
options: A Meter instance
'cm'
The type string
undefined because static fields are erased
questions.explanation: Static fields are accessed on the class and emit as runtime members.
questions.explanationAr: الـ static fields بتتوصل من الـ class وبتظهر كأعضاء وقت التشغيل.

questions.code: class User { constructor(public id: number) {} }
questions.question: What is the type of the instance property id?
questions.explanation: The parameter annotation supplies the declared type of the generated property.
questions.explanationAr: الـ annotation بتحدد نوع الـ property اللي اتولدت من الـ parameter.

questions.code: ____ Device { powered = false; }
questions.explanation: class introduces a class declaration.
questions.explanationAr: class بتبدأ تعريف class.

questions.prompt: Add the special initializer method to this class.
questions.code: class User { ____ (name: string) {} }
questions.explanation: The constructor method runs when a class instance is created.
questions.explanationAr: method constructor بتشتغل لما instance من الـ class تتعمل.

questions.prompt: Restrict this field to its declaring class.
questions.code: class Vault { ____ secret = 'x'; }
questions.explanation: private restricts access to the declaring class in TypeScript checking.
questions.explanationAr: private بيقصر الوصول على الـ class اللي عرفته أثناء الفحص.

questions.prompt: Allow this member to be used in subclasses.
questions.code: class Base { ____ count = 0; }
questions.explanation: protected permits access from subclasses as well as the declaring class.
questions.explanationAr: protected بيسمح بالوصول من الـ subclasses وكمان الـ class الأصلية.

questions.prompt: Create an instance property from this constructor argument.
questions.code: class User { constructor(____ name: string) {} }
questions.explanation: A parameter property modifier creates a property from the constructor parameter.
questions.explanationAr: modifier الـ parameter property بيعمل property من parameter الـ constructor.

questions.prompt: Check the instance shape against the named contract.
questions.code: class Clock ____ HasTime { time = 0; }
questions.explanation: implements checks that the class instance conforms to the interface.
questions.explanationAr: implements بيتأكد إن instance الـ class متوافقة مع الـ interface.

questions.prompt: Declare a base class that cannot be instantiated directly.
questions.code: ____ class Shape { abstract area(): number; }
questions.explanation: An abstract class can define a base contract but cannot be directly instantiated.
questions.explanationAr: الـ abstract class بتحدد عقد أساسي لكن ماينفعش تتعمل منها instance مباشرة.

questions.prompt: Declare a class-level value rather than an instance field.
questions.code: class Counter { ____ total = 0; }
questions.explanation: static places the member on the class constructor.
questions.explanationAr: static بتحط العضو على الـ class constructor.

questions.question: How do public, protected, and private differ in a class?
keyPoints: public is accessible from any context
protected is accessible in the class and subclasses
private restricts use to the declaring class in TypeScript checking
questions.modelAnswer: public members can be accessed from any visibility context. protected members are available within the declaring class and subclasses, while private members are restricted to the declaring class during TypeScript checking. These modifiers affect the typed API, though ECMAScript #private fields have distinct runtime privacy semantics.
questions.explanation: The visibility level controls which code can use a member through the class type.
questions.explanationAr: مستوى الوصول بيحدد الكود اللي يقدر يستخدم العضو من خلال نوع الـ class.

questions.question: What are parameter properties, and what tradeoff do they introduce?
keyPoints: They declare and initialize a property from a constructor parameter
They use access or readonly modifiers
They shorten syntax but can hide field setup
questions.modelAnswer: A parameter property uses a modifier such as public, private, protected, or readonly on a constructor parameter. TypeScript creates the corresponding property and initializes it from the argument. This reduces boilerplate but should remain clear to readers reviewing class state.
questions.explanation: Parameter properties combine a constructor parameter with a class property declaration.
questions.explanationAr: الـ parameter property بتجمع بين parameter وproperty في الـ class.

questions.question: How do abstract classes differ from interfaces as class contracts?
keyPoints: An abstract class can provide implementation and state
An interface describes a type shape without runtime implementation
A class can extend one class and implement interfaces
questions.modelAnswer: An abstract class can provide shared implementation and state while requiring subclasses to complete abstract members. An interface describes a structural contract and does not provide runtime method bodies. A class can extend one base class and implement multiple interfaces.
questions.explanation: Choose based on whether a shared runtime base implementation is needed.
questions.explanationAr: الاختيار حسب الحاجة لتنفيذ أساسي مشترك وقت التشغيل.

questions.question: How can a class satisfy strictPropertyInitialization?
keyPoints: Initialize fields at declaration or in every constructor path
Use a definite-assignment assertion only when initialization is guaranteed elsewhere
Avoid assertions that hide a real uninitialized state
questions.modelAnswer: Initialize a property at its declaration or assign it along every constructor path. A definite-assignment assertion can silence the check when initialization is guaranteed through another mechanism, but it does not initialize anything at runtime. Use it only when that external guarantee is reliable.
questions.explanation: The compiler check helps reveal uninitialized instance state but cannot create runtime values.
questions.explanationAr: الفحص بيكشف حالة غير مهيأة لكنه مش بينشئ قيم وقت التشغيل.
